University of Warsaw Degree Programmes: 1st, 2nd and long cycle studies (Bachelor and Master)

Main siteEducationDegree Programmes: 1st, 2nd and long cycle studies (Bachelor and Master)

Degree Programmes: 1st, 2nd and long cycle studies (Bachelor and Master)

 

The University of Warsaw is among the top 3% of the world’s universities according to global ranking such as Times Higher Education World University Ranking (THE), Quaquarelli Symmonds World University Ranking (QS), Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU).

 

In 2023, the university performed very well in Shanghai’s Global Ranking of Academic Subjects (GRAS 2023), which included seven scientific disciplines taught at the university. Mathematics and Physics were ranked 101-150 worldwide. Read more about the international position and the quality of education at UW

 

The candidates are offered:

  • over 300 programmes of 1st, 2nd and long cycle – uniform Master’s studies in Polish in the humanities, social, exact and natural sciences, as well as numerous interdisciplinary programmes which combine knowledge and skills in various fields
  • over 20 double degree programmes run by UW and international partners
  • 42 English-language programmes
